### Bible Pathway - Feb. 21, 2010
Author: Bible Pathway Ministries
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathway-feb-21-2010-11626510.html
Passage: Numbers 19:2-9
Points:
- The red heifer sacrifice was established during a period in the wilderness when Israel was heavily confronted with death and impurity.
- Ashes from the burnt heifer were combined with running water to create a cleansing solution that restored defiled individuals to God.
- The ceremony foreshadowed Jesus Christ, whose sacrificial death cleanses the conscience and grants true renewal of life.
- The ordinance underscores God's call to personal holiness, warning believers to guard their thoughts, speech, and associations from spiritual defilement.
- Through faith and prayer, Christians allow Christ to dwell within them and reproduce His character in daily living.
